title: Container Bookings: releasing empty equipment to the customer's haulier
content:
## Policy clause
Under the Container Bookings product line, empty equipment is released against a confirmed booking on the customer's request, and only when every applicable condition below holds on the line's records:
1. **Release window.** Empty equipment is released no earlier than the tier's earliest-release days before the scheduled departure date. The earliest release date is the ETD minus the tier's release days in whole calendar days, and release on that date itself is allowed.
2. **Prepayment.** For a cash-in-advance customer on a tier with the prepayment setting, the booking's charges due must be 0.00 before release; credit-approved customers are never held for prepayment.
3. **Dangerous goods.** A booking with dangerous-goods cargo may be released only when its dangerous-goods acceptance is approved.
4. **Reefer.** A booking with reefer cargo may be released only when its reefer service has passed pre-trip inspection.

**Equipment shortage.** When the booked 40DV is short at the depot and the tier's free substitution setting is yes, a 40HC is released at no extra charge; otherwise the customer waits for the booked type or amends it under the amendment rules, and tiers with guaranteed equipment are never left waiting.

Release opens the export free-time record of the booking under the demurrage and detention product rules.

## Date boundary cases (hypothetical release days)
*Hypothetical tier releasing 8 calendar days before ETD, for illustration only:* for an ETD of 20 October the earliest release date is 12 October. A release on 12 October is allowed; a request to release on 11 October is too early.

## Prepayment truth table
| Customer credit standing | Tier prepayment setting | Charges due on the booking | Prepayment condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| cash in advance | yes | 0.00 | met |
| cash in advance | yes | above 0.00 | not met; no release |
| cash in advance | no | any | not applicable |
| credit approved | yes or no | any | never held for prepayment |

## Points of judgement
**The booking carries dangerous goods and the acceptance is still pending.** It may not be released; approval is required.

**The booking is reefer and pre-trip inspection has not passed.** It may not be released.
